The organization, the ticket to comment on or the subject of a new ticket, and the message. The /organizations/support/tickets/create API accepts requests in the following format:

CreateSupportTicketRequest Model - Request body to open a support ticket or comment on a ticket.
organizationId string
required
example: 5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691
Id of the organization.
subject string
example: Live algorithm stopped after a brokerage disconnection
Subject of the new ticket. Required to open a new ticket.
message string
required
example: My live algorithm stopped at 10:32 ET after the brokerage disconnected.
HTML body of the message.
hash string
Id of the ticket to comment on. To open a new ticket, omit this property.
close boolean
If true, close the ticket after you add the comment. Requires hash.
projectId integer
Optional. Id of one of your projects to attach to the new ticket. To get your project Ids, use the /projects/read endpoint.
backtestId string
Optional. Id of a backtest of the attached project to attach to the new ticket. Requires projectId. To get the backtest Ids of a project, use the /backtests/list endpoint.
deployId string
Optional. Id of a stopped live deployment of the attached project to attach to the new ticket. Requires projectId. To get the deployment Ids of a project, use the /live/list endpoint.
agentDeploymentId string
Optional. Id of an AI conversation of the attached project to attach to the new ticket. Requires projectId. To get the conversation Ids of a project, use the /agents/deployments/list endpoint.
Example 
{
  "organizationId": "5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691",
  "subject": "Live algorithm stopped after a brokerage disconnection",
  "message": "My live algorithm stopped at 10:32 ET after the brokerage disconnected.",
  "hash": "string",
  "close": true,
  "projectId": 0,
  "backtestId": "string",
  "deployId": "string",
  "agentDeploymentId": "string"
}
